import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variant
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island extra spaces
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Fix sex case variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Ensure body_mass_g is numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Drop out-of-range body_mass_g values
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grouped = df.dropna(subset=['species']).groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
